# vgi4bio

<!-- badges: start -->
[![Travis build status](https://travis-ci.com/KarinePrince/vgi4bio.svg?branch=master)](https://travis-ci.com/KarinePrince/vgi4bio)
<!-- badges: end -->

The package of vgi4bio contains functions to estimate relative species abundances from opportunistic records, using data combination methods.
To have an overview of the package, read the vignette after installing the package by:

``` {r, eval=F}
vignette("tutorial", package = "vgi4bio")
```


## Installing *vgi4bio*

To install the development version from GitHub:

1. Install the release version of devtools from CRAN with install.packages("devtools").

2. Make sure you have a working development environment.

- Windows: Install Rtools.
- Mac: Install Xcode from the Mac App Store.
- Linux: Install a compiler and various development libraries (details vary across different flavors of Linux).

Then:

``` {r, eval=F}
library(devtools)
install_github("KarinePrince/vgi4bio")
```

The stable version can be installed from [CRAN](https://CRAN.R-project.org) using:

``` {r, eval=F}
install.packages("vgi4bio")
```
  
Once installed, the package can be loaded using:  

``` {r, eval=F}
library(vgi4bio)
```

*Note that this package was build with R 3.6, so you might have to update your R installation.*
